summary: Set type: http and a path URL in the MCP registry to register a remote server without installing it; to support both modes, include vars/remote.yml when <role>_mode is remote and pass -e cfn_mcp_mode=remote at build time.
questions: How do I configure a remote MCP server in an execution environment?
Can an MCP role support both local and remote modes?
What happens when MCP registry type is http?
